name: @immunity-wars/property
description: Task D property/invariant suite: generative legal play, checked against invariants the engine does not enforce
comment:exports: Task E's state-size instrument needs the ENVELOPE of the projection — which fields ever carry a value — and this runner is the only generator that reaches the 8 actions the reference bot never emits (net, resengulf, resmove, hop, recall, antivenom, orderAntivenom, undo). Exporting it beats reimplementing injectExtra inside tests/balance, which is how two generators drift apart and stop agreeing about what a legal game is. Same reasoning as the equivalence package's exports map, which this follows.
